text: むしよけスプレーは　むし　どころか　ポケモンも　よって　こないよ　つよい　ポケモンを　いちばん　まえ…　つまり　ポケモン　リストの　ひだりがわに　おいて　おけば　こうかは　ばいぞう　だ！

structure.jp: むし　どころか　ポケモンも　よって　こないよ
structure.en: never mind bugs, even Pokémon won't come near

structure.jp: つよい　ポケモンを　いちばん　まえ…
structure.en: a strong Pokémon at the very front...

structure.jp: つまり　ポケモン　リストの　ひだりがわに　おいて　おけば
structure.en: that is, if you put it on the left side of the Pokémon list

structure.jp: こうかは　ばいぞう　だ！

patterns.name: 〜どころか
patterns.explanation: どころか after a word says 'never mind that, it goes much further'. むし　どころか = 'never mind bugs'.

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. おいて　おけば = 'if you put it there'.

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: ておく after a verb says you do it ahead of time and leave it that way. Here the verb おく 'to put' appears twice: once as the action and once as this ending. おいて　おけば = 'if you put it there and leave it'.
